explain.EXPLAIN_AGREE: All {{n}} revisions agree: {{changes}} platform changes, {{hold}} min total hold, weighted delay {{weighted}}.

changes.none: No train differs from the applied plan.
reason.title: Reason card
reason.FROZEN: Departed or at its platform at now — fixed
reason.FROZEN_DEPARTURE_DELAY: At {{platform}}; departure {{minutes}} min late as reported
reason.MOVED_OCCUPIED: Moved {{from}} → {{to}}: {{from}} occupied by {{train}} until {{until}} + {{gap}} min gap
reason.HELD_OCCUPIED: Held {{minutes}} min: {{platform}} occupied by {{train}} until {{until}} + {{gap}} min gap
reason.UNASSIGNED: No platform free for {{stay}} min within {{max_hold}} min of {{earliest}}; blocked by {{blockers}}
conflict.measureOverlap: trains overlap {{stay}} min ({{reserved}} min of reserved platform time)
conflictDesc.MISSING_TRAIN: A timetable train is missing from the plan
conflictDesc.DUPLICATE_TRAIN: A train appears more than once
conflictDesc.UNKNOWN_TRAIN: A train that is not in the timetable
conflictDesc.REQUIRED_PLATFORM: The required platform is not used
conflictDesc.NOT_ALLOWED_PLATFORM: The platform is not allowed for this train
conflictDesc.DWELL_CHANGED: The stay differs from the dwell plus reported departure delay
conflictDesc.EARLIER_THAN_POSSIBLE: Arrives earlier than its reported delay allows
conflictDesc.HOLD_EXCEEDED: Held longer than the maximum hold
conflictDesc.FROZEN_CHANGED: A departed or at-platform train was changed
conflictDesc.GAP_VIOLATION: Minimum clearance between trains not kept
conflictDesc.OVERLAP: Two trains on the platform at the same time
conflictDesc.CLOSURE_VIOLATION: Occupies a platform during its closure
conflictDesc.CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: The train does not fit the platform
conflictDesc.UNASSIGNED_WITHOUT_REASON: No platform and no reason given (no platform scheduled)
